remarks:
Value range pricing: Sellers will consider offers between $500,000.00 and $550,000.00.
A move-in-ready home that blends everyday comfort with standout entertainment features and a convenient Orchard Park location. The bedrooms feature adjustable LED lighting, allowing each space to be customized to suit different moods and styles. A spacious recreation room adds even more versatility, creating an ideal space for gatherings, game nights, or relaxing at home. The outdoor areas, including a large, heated in-ground pool, covered deck, and hot tub, provide additional space to enjoy the property, entertain guests, or simply unwind.
The property has been thoughtfully set up with short-term rental use in mind, presenting an attractive opportunity for a buyer interested in pursuing that type of use. Furnishings are negotiable. Stove, double oven, refrigerator, and dishwasher are included in the sale. At the same time, the home is equally well suited for an owner-occupant seeking a residence with plenty of character, recreation space, and convenience.
Located approximately 3 miles from Highmark Stadium, the home provides convenient access to Bills games, major events, shopping, dining, and surrounding amenities. Offers are being reviewed as they are received.
